title: Click-ExM enables expansion microscopy for all biomolecules
protocol: Prepare a 100 mM Alk-Cho stock solution using ddH₂O.
Dilute the Alk-Cho stock into cell culture medium to a final concentration of 100-200 μM for labeling medium preparation.
Culture cells in the labeling medium for 12 hours at 37°C.
Wash cells with PBS three times.
Fix cells with 3% (w/v) formaldehyde and 0.1% (v/v) glutaraldehyde in PBS for 15 minutes.
Treat cells with 0.1% (w/v) sodium borohydride for 7 minutes, then wash three times with 100 mM glycine in PBS.
Permeabilize cells with 0.1% (w/v) saponin in PBS for 5 minutes and wash three times with PBS.
Prepare 188 μL of 1×PBS.
Pipette 1 μL of azide-PEG3-biotin (10 mM).
Add 1 μL of BTTAA/CuSO4 complex (6:1, mol/mol, 10 mM).
Mix with 10 μL of sodium ascorbate (50 mM, freshly prepared).
Incubate cells with the mixture for 1 hour with gentle shaking.
Wash cells with PBS five times.
Incubate cells with 5 μg/mL streptavidin-dye in PBS containing 1% (w/v) BSA for 1 hour.
Wash cells three times with PBS.
Incubate samples with 0.1 mg/mL AcX in PBS at room temperature overnight, or incubate the cells with 0.25% (v/v) GA in PBS for 10 minutes.
Wash samples three times with PBS.
Prepare monomer solution using 1×PBS.
Add 2 M NaCl to the monomer solution.
Mix in 2.5% (w/v) acrylamide.
Pipette 0.15% (w/v) N,N'-methylenebisacrylamide into the solution.
Add 8.625% (w/v) sodium acrylate to complete the monomer solution.
Prepare a gelation solution by mixing 940 μL of monomer solution.
Add 20 μL of ddH₂O to the mixture.
Mix in 20 μL of freshly prepared 10% (w/w) TEMED.
Add 20 μL of freshly prepared 10% (w/w) APS to complete the gelation solution preparation.
Incubate samples with the gelation solution at 4 °C for 5 minutes.
Transfer the incubated samples to a humidified 37 °C incubator for 1 hour.
Prepare a digestion solution containing 50 mM Tris, pH 8.0.
Add 1 mM EDTA to the digestion solution.
Mix in 0.1% (v/v) Triton X-100.
Include 0.8 M guanidine HCl in the digestion buffer.
Add 8 units/mL of proteinase K immediately before use.
Digest the hydrogel in the digestion buffer at 37 °C for different time periods: typically, 4 hours for AcX-anchored samples and 2 hours for GA-anchored samples.
Store the gel temporarily in PBS at 4 ℃ if necessary (note potential signal loss or distortion with long-term storage).
Place the hydrogel into ddH₂O to expand.
Change the water every 20 minutes until expansion is complete.
Coat 24×50 mm rectangular No. 1.5 coverglasses with 0.1 mg mL^-1 poly-D-lysine for 10 min at room temperature and allow to dry.
Remove excess water carefully using laboratory wipes, and place the expanded samples on the coverglasses.
Set up microscope and perform imaging.
Find the region of interest using low-magnification objectives with long working distance.
Switch to high-magnification objectives for detailed imaging.
